title: minearchive
description: Blue Archive fan mod for MC 1.20.1 Forge adds new enchantments no table needed and foods unofficial no official assets used
body:
# _________________________________
Regarding new content and version ports

The MC version currently supported by the module

Currently, we only support 1.20.1

Other versions are undergoing further testing

Currently, only Forge is supported

We have currently added several enchantments and some foods

For example, some items allow you to enchant without an enchantment table

# _________________________________

You just need to place the module in the same position as the other modules

You just need to place the module in /mods

The server side is the same

No obvious compatibility issues have been found so far

If there really is a problem, please report it [here](https://github.com/TransferStation-ai/minearchive/issues)

Some items are very useful in certain situations and can even provide you with some fun

Unofficial secondary creations only reference Blue Archive-related content and do not use official materials
